comment: x = the analysis level of a stimulus: 'phys:<key>' is a value measured on the degraded clip (DegradeResult.physical), 'rubato_removed_log' = tempo_log_sd_before - tempo_log_sd_after, 'log2_inverse_level' = log2(1 / factor). 'main' (null until the pilot) holds {dimension: {'det': [x targets], 'pref': [x targets]}}; build --ladder main then solves the control level per excerpt that reaches each x target. Excerpt and ladder spec for scripts/build_study_s03.py. Bar ranges are measure ROW indices (0-based, unfolded order; row 0 is the pickup where there is one), inclusive. Excerpt ids are neutral codes: the app never shows composer, piece or performer. 'performance' = 'median_tempo' picks, among the source's performances of the piece, the one with the median overall tempo (F-03 tempo_bpm_overall; the lower one on a tie).

timing_jitter.note: onset s.d. / local IOI; added IOI CV = sqrt(2) x this; van Vugt 2013 threshold IOI CV about 0.08 -> onset CV about 0.057

pedal_blur.note: every cleanly pedalled harmony change is blurred by a late pedal change this many beats after it (capped at the next change); graded by lateness because the clips have only 1-11 detected changes

control_range.comment: search range of the control parameter when a main-study ladder is given as x targets (build --ladder main); x must grow from the first to the second value

catch.note: gross wrong-note version: attention / lapse check in both parts
